---
title: "Prostate variable-selection study + unique-gene figure (supplement Appendix E, Figures E.1-E.2)"
output: html_document
---

Selection-frequency analysis on the prostate data.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
```

```{r selection-frequency}
spec <- load_prostate_raw()            # raw 6033 genes
n_reps <- 500; train_ratio <- 0.7

proj_root <- here::here()
stopifnot(file.exists(file.path(proj_root, "R", "00_setup.R")))

cl <- makeCluster(max(1, detectCores() - 1)); registerDoParallel(cl)
cpp_exports <- c("d_tpsc_cpp", "tpsc_nll_cpp", "tpsc_transform_cpp",
                 "tpsc_rowloglik_cpp")
res <- foreach(r = seq_len(n_reps),
               .packages = c("Rcpp","glmnet","MASS","randomForest","lightgbm"),
               .noexport = cpp_exports,
               .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
  source(file.path(proj_root, "R", "00_setup.R"))
  set.seed(1012 + r)
  idx <- sample(nrow(spec$X), floor(train_ratio * nrow(spec$X)))
  sp  <- make_split(spec, idx)          # train-only MD screen to 200 genes
  yq  <- as.numeric(as.character(sp$y_train))

  f_s <- fit_srollr(sp$X_train, sp$y_train, nfolds = 3)
  f_l <- cv.glmnet(sp$X_train, yq, family = "binomial", alpha = 1)
  co  <- as.matrix(coef(f_l, s = "lambda.min"))

  # RF and LightGBM feature-importance rankings.
  yf     <- factor(as.character(sp$y_train), levels = c("0", "1"))
  f_rf   <- randomForest(x = sp$X_train, y = yf, ntree = 200, importance = TRUE)
  imp_rf <- randomForest::importance(f_rf, type = 1)    
  rf_imp <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(imp_rf), Score = imp_rf[, 1],
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  dtrain   <- lgb.Dataset(data = sp$X_train, label = yq)
  f_lg     <- lgb.train(list(objective = "binary", metric = "auc", verbose = -1),
                        dtrain, nrounds = 100, verbose = -1)
  lgbm_imp <- as.data.frame(lgb.importance(f_lg)) 

  list(rep = r,
       srollr   = srollr_selected(f_s),
       l1rl     = setdiff(rownames(co)[co[, 1] != 0], "(Intercept)"),
       rf_imp   = rf_imp,
       lgbm_imp = lgbm_imp)
}
stopCluster(cl); registerDoSEQ()

ok <- vapply(res, function(x) is.list(x) && !is.null(x[["srollr"]]), logical(1))
if (!any(ok))
  stop("All ", n_reps, " reps failed. First worker error:\n  ",
       conditionMessage(res[[which(!ok)[1]]]))
if (!all(ok))
  message(sum(!ok), " of ", n_reps, " reps failed; keeping ", sum(ok), ".")
sel <- res[ok]

# selection frequencies
freq <- function(field)
  sort(table(unlist(lapply(sel, `[[`, field))), decreasing = TRUE)
srollr_freq <- freq("srollr"); l1rl_freq <- freq("l1rl")
head(srollr_freq, 15)

# Average model size -> k_bar, rounded exactly as the previous version did.
k_bar_srollr <- round(mean(vapply(sel, function(x) length(x$srollr), numeric(1))))  # ~7
k_bar_l1rl   <- round(mean(vapply(sel, function(x) length(x$l1rl),   numeric(1))))  # ~10

# Mean tree-ensemble importance across reps, then rank (as calc_avg_importance).
agg_imp <- function(field, score_col) {
  comb <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sel, function(x) {
    d <- x[[field]]
    data.frame(Feature = d$Feature, Score = d[[score_col]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  a <- aggregate(Score ~ Feature, data = comb, FUN = mean)
  a[order(a$Score, decreasing = TRUE), ]
}
rf_avg   <- agg_imp("rf_imp",   "Score")
lgbm_avg <- agg_imp("lgbm_imp", "Gain")

# Top-k_bar consensus sets.
top_srollr <- names(srollr_freq)[seq_len(min(k_bar_srollr, length(srollr_freq)))]
top_l1rl   <- names(l1rl_freq)[seq_len(min(k_bar_l1rl,   length(l1rl_freq)))]
top_rf     <- rf_avg$Feature[seq_len(min(k_bar_l1rl, nrow(rf_avg)))]
top_lgbm   <- lgbm_avg$Feature[seq_len(min(k_bar_l1rl, nrow(lgbm_avg)))]

# The highlighted gene: one S-RoLLR selects frequently but L1-RL, RF and LightGBM all overlook.
unique_gene <- setdiff(top_srollr, c(top_l1rl, top_rf, top_lgbm))[1]
if (is.na(unique_gene))
  stop("No S-RoLLR-unique gene found among the top ", k_bar_srollr,
       "; nothing to highlight.")
cat("Highlighted gene:", unique_gene,
    " S-RoLLR count:", srollr_freq[[unique_gene]],
    " L1-RL count:", if (unique_gene %in% names(l1rl_freq)) l1rl_freq[[unique_gene]] else 0,
    "\n")
saveRDS(list(srollr_freq = srollr_freq, l1rl_freq = l1rl_freq,
             rf_avg = rf_avg, lgbm_avg = lgbm_avg,
             k_bar = list(srollr = k_bar_srollr, l1rl = k_bar_l1rl),
             unique_gene = unique_gene),
        here::here("results", "variable_selection_freq.rds"))
```
